notes.title: Steam Next Fest Dev Live Vol.2 on Feb 10th
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

I just wanted to give you all a heads-up that the live streaming of the Steam Next Fest developer session for Endless Loop is scheduled to take place on February 10th at 20:00 China Standard Time / February 10th at 04:00 Pacific. So make sure to mark your calendars and set reminders, as you won't want to miss out on this Gameplay showcase! We are looking forward to seeing you there!

Endless Loop Team
